say:3:1029777002:1.text: A big festival with everyone gathered... I'll be sure to let Lyca and the others know.
say:3:1029777002:1.source_cn: 众人齐聚的庆典，以及热闹的集市啊……我会转达给莱卡她们的。

say:4:1029777003:1.text: They were saying earlier that if they had time, they'd love to bring Granny Dahnie here.
say:4:1029777003:1.source_cn: 她们此前还说过，如果有空，想带达赫妮婆婆过来购物来着。

say:6:1029777004:0.text: What about you, Bryon? Will you join us too?

say:7:1029777005:1.text: For me, it's a bit too noisy. I prefer things a little quieter.
say:7:1029777005:1.source_cn: 对我来说有些太吵了，我更喜欢安静的环境。

say:8:1029777006:1.text: Still, things have been getting lively in the Dark Forest and Vaduso Mountains lately. Lyca and the others are busier than ever.
say:8:1029777006:1.source_cn: 不过，最近薄暮丛林和瓦度索山脉也变得热闹了许多，莱卡她...

say:9:1029777007:1.text: Technically, I wasn't supposed to take time off. But Elona had plans with her friend, so I figured I'd visit here.
say:9:1029777007:1.source_cn: 原本我不该请假的，但艾洛娜似乎与她的友人们有约，所以我...

choice_prompt:10:1029777007.text: Technically, I wasn't supposed to take time off. But Elona had plans with her friend, so I figured I'd visit here.
choice_prompt:10:1029777007.source_cn: 原本我不该请假的，但艾洛娜似乎与她的友人们有约，所以我才来到这里。

say:11:1029777008:1.text: Oh, right! Bryon, what kind of clothes did Elona and her friend get you? Why aren't you wearing them?
say:11:1029777008:1.source_cn: 对哦！布莱恩，艾洛娜的朋友们给你买的衣服是什么样的？你...

say:12:1029777009:1.text:
...
I tried it on once, and... I didn't think it was appropriate to wear in public...
say:12:1029777009:1.source_cn: ……\n我试穿过一次，个人体验上来说，认为不太适合在公...

say:13:1029777010:1.text: Between how revealing it was and Lyca's reaction—let's just say there was a lot of laughing involved...
say:13:1029777010:1.source_cn: 无论是裸露的面积，还是莱卡她们在看到的时候的笑声……

choice_prompt:14:1029777010.text: Between how revealing it was and Lyca's reaction—let's just say there was a lot of laughing involved...
choice_prompt:14:1029777010.source_cn: 无论是裸露的面积，还是莱卡她们在看到的时候的笑声……

say:15:1029777011:1.text: Sorry, I'm afraid that won't be happening. Well! Looks like Elona needs me. Please excuse me.
say:15:1029777011:1.source_cn: 抱歉，恐怕不能如愿了，艾洛娜似乎有事叫我，那么，我先告辞。

say:16:1029777012:1.text: If I'm still around when the festival begins, I'll attend.
say:16:1029777012:1.source_cn: 如果庆典开始时我还没有离开的话，我会来参加的。
